component.name: PlayerScreen
component.script:
sub init() m.top.streamUrl = "" m.top.streamFormat = "hls" m.top.contentTitle = "" m.player = m.top.findNode("player") m.bufferingLabel = m.top.findNode("bufferingLabel") end sub
sub playStream() if m.top.streamUrl <> "" m.player.content.streamformat = m.top.streamFormat m.player.content.url = m.top.streamUrl m.player.visible = true m.bufferingLabel.visible = false m.player.play() end if end sub
sub onKeyDown(key as Integer) ' Handle playback controls select case key case 285 ' Play/Pause if m.player.state = "playing" m.player.pause() else m.player.resume() end if case 283 ' Back m.player.stop() m.player.visible = false m.top.close() end select end sub
sub close() print "Closing player" end sub
